title: Updates on Leverage, Margin Tiers, and Funding Rate Settlement Frequency of USDⓈ-M BNXUSDT Perpetual Contract (2025-02-09)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will make adjustments to the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M BNXUSDT Perpetual Contract at  2025-02-09 12:15 (UTC) .  Existing positions  opened before the update  will not be affected .  New Leverage & Margin Tiers: USDⓈ-M BNXUSDT Perpetual Contract Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 16 - 20x 0 < Position ≤ 10,000 1.00% 9 - 10x 0 < Position ≤ 10,000 1.00% 11 - 15x 10,000 < Position ≤ 20,000 1.50% 8x 10,000 < Position ≤ 20,000 1.50% 9 - 10x 20,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 2.00% 7x 20,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 2.00% 7 - 8x 100,000 < Position ≤ 200,000 2.50% 6x 100,000 < Position ≤ 200,000 2.50% 6x 200,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 5.00% 5x 200,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 5.00% 5x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 2,000,000 10.00% 4x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 2,000,000 10.00% 3 - 4x 2,000,000 < Position ≤ 2,500,000 12.50% 3x 2,000,000 < Position ≤ 2,500,000 12.50% 2x 2,500,000 < Position ≤ 3,000,000 25.00% 2x 2,500,000 < Position ≤ 3,000,000 25.00% 1x 3,000,000 < Position ≤ 3,500,000 50.00% 1x 3,000,000 < Position ≤ 3,500,000 50.00% In addition, Binance Futures will increase the funding rate settlement frequency of the USDⓈ-M BNXUSDT Perpetual Contract from every eight hours to  every four hours  starting from  2025-02-09 12:30 (UTC) . The detailed arrangement is as follows: Time Max Funding Rate 2025-02-09 16:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-02-09 20:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-02-10 00:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-02-10 04:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … Notes: In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M BNXUSDT Perpetual Contract  without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each  margin tier , updating  funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the  Last Price Protected mechanism  to update the Mark Price.
